script.es: Tu piel, en las mejores manos.
script.en: Your skin, in the best hands.

parrafo.es: Un med spa en Kendall donde cada tratamiento se adapta a tu piel: faciales personalizados, microneedling, masajes y terapia de luz LED, en un ambiente tranquilo pensado para relajarte de verdad.
parrafo.en: A med spa in Kendall where every treatment is tailored to your skin: custom facials, microneedling, massage and LED light therapy, in a calm space made for real relaxation.

parrafo_1.es: Skin Spa by Techy Carreno es un med spa en Kendall dirigido por Carlos y Techy, con años dedicados al cuidado de la piel. Nuestras clientas destacan que no es un spa más: es un equipo que evalúa tu piel y personaliza cada tratamiento antes de empezar.
parrafo_1.en: Skin Spa by Techy Carreno is a med spa in Kendall run by Carlos and Techy, with years dedicated to skin care. Our clients tell us it is not just another spa: it is a team that assesses your skin and customizes every treatment before starting.

parrafo_2.es: El espacio está pensado para relajarte de verdad: música suave, aromaterapia y una barra de té y café que recibe a cada clienta. Facial, microneedling, masaje o terapia de luz LED, siempre con la misma atención al detalle.
parrafo_2.en: The space is built for real relaxation: soft music, aromatherapy and a tea and coffee bar that greets every client. Facial, microneedling, massage or LED light therapy, always with the same attention to detail.

subtitulo.en: 206 Google reviews back up Carlos and Techy's work.

items.quote: I had a wonderful experience at this spa! From the moment I arrived, the staff was welcoming, professional, and attentive, the place was clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained. The esthetician Maria Teresa took the time to assess my skin and customize the treatment to my needs.

They are not just a spa, they are a team of professionals who actually care about you, your skin; they guide you through every treatment and explain how everything works. My face never looked so good as it does now since I started my treatment with them.

Techy is incredible. She has this calming, nurturing, almost healing energy that you just feel the moment you walk in. I'm really picky about places I go to for massages, facials, or microneedling, and somehow every single visit here meets and goes way beyond my expectations.
